watchlist_posts_7d.text: October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month. The American Cancer Society says women 45 to 54 should get a mammogram every year. Talk with your care team about your schedule. #BreastCancerAwareness https://t.co/6Sp3SGxtCi https://t.co/AvI3NBsAFW

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: October note: know how your skin and breasts normally look and feel, and tell your care team about changes. The American Cancer Society lists skin changes as one thing to watch for. #BreastCancerAwareness https://t.co/g2ztRGG6RY https://t.co/bh8HM4S2tj

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Your skin is not betraying you. If it suddenly stings, tightens, or flushes, it may be asking for fewer products, not more. Here is a gentle skincare reset for menopause skin. #MenopauseSkin #SkinCare https://t.co/6Sp3SGwVMK https://t.co/wOK49IWZSB

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Barrier first, always. A calm, hydrated barrier is the base every other step builds on, especially when menopause #skin runs dry. #SkinBarrier #Menopause https://t.co/g2ztRGFz2q https://t.co/klmLCpbd3c

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Does your skin feel thinner and more fragile than it used to? Falling estrogen is linked to lower collagen and thinner skin. Here is how to support #skin density in menopause. #MenopauseSkin #SkinCare https://t.co/g2ztRGFz2q https://t.co/MvSQWehfWJ

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Not every active belongs in every season. When menopause skin feels sensitive, pause exfoliating #acids first, then bring them back one at a time. #MenopauseSkin #SkinCare #skin https://t.co/6Sp3SGxtCi https://t.co/D1jKwCyJPC

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Dermatologists advise warm water, not hot, and moisturizing while #skin is still damp. Two simple steps that support a tired menopause skin barrier this winter. #WinterSkin #Menopause #skinbarrier  https://t.co/6Sp3SGwVMK https://t.co/lJ5tiipUWn

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Pause. Restore. Reintroduce. Three gentle phases for sensitive menopause skin, with no set number of days. Your skin leads, and you move on when it feels ready. #MenopauseSkin https://t.co/6Sp3SGwVMK https://t.co/rTcTlr45kF

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Cleanse gently. Hydrate on damp skin. Seal with a cream. See a gentle #skin care routine I share for a beautiful skincare reset in menopause. #MenopauseSkin #SkinCare https://t.co/6Sp3SGwVMK https://t.co/dOtXoC0MMT

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Skin density support is a system, not one product. A strong barrier, antioxidants, gentle Vitamin A at night, daily sunscreen, and good inner nutrition all play a part. #MenopauseSkin https://t.co/g2ztRGFz2q https://t.co/BqtvHgD3nf

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Gentle Vitamin A at night can fit a skin density routine once your barrier feels calm. Start slowly, and pause if your skin stings. #MenopauseSkin #SkinCare https://t.co/g2ztRGG6RY https://t.co/FbrUrdy6qf

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: A 2025 study found postmenopausal participants reported significantly more skin itchiness. Dry, reactive skin in menopause is real, and it is not your fault. #Menopause #SkinHealth https://t.co/6Sp3SGxtCi https://t.co/t02WlTQLQG

watchlist_posts_7d.text: Ready to support your skin from the inside out? Get my free REGENERATE guide and start with one small step today. #MenopauseSkin #Menopause https://t.co/5HMAZlk9uj https://t.co/MjSejJ7fJW

drafts_today.text: Cold nights and a stressed skin barrier? Try fewer products, not more. Cleanse gently, hydrate on damp skin, seal with a cream. That is the whole winter reset. 🌿 #SkinBarrier #WinterSkin
Over 45 and your skin suddenly stings, tightens or flushes? It is not betraying you. Pause the acids, calm the barrier, then bring actives back one at a time. #MenopauseSkin #SkinCare

Hot water feels amazing on a chilly Sechelt morning, but your skin barrier disagrees. Warm, not hot, and moisturize within a minute while skin is still damp. Small habit, big difference. #WinterSkin #SkinBarrier
